// Classifier fixture, vitest: PRINTS-SUCCESS and its negatives. Read as text by tests/classify.test.ts.
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

describe("prints success", () => {
  it("creates the account", async () => {
    try {
      await createAccount();
      console.log("✅ Account created successfully");
    } catch (error) {
      console.log("Account creation failed", error);
    }
  });

  it("verifies the system is operational", async () => {
    const health = await check();
    expect(health).toBeDefined();
    console.log(`🎉 System fully functional: ${health.version}`);
  });

  it("requests a password reset", async () => {
    await reset();
    console.log("password reset requested");
  });

  it("checks health after printing", async () => {
    console.log("all tests passing so far");
    const health = await check();
    expect(health.status).toBe("ok");
  });
});
